key_insight: A reinforcement-learning plus predictor-funnel pipeline designed novel MOFs that balance photocatalytic performance with stability, cost, sustainability, and adsorption under multi-objective constraints.
engineering_relevance: The workflow offers a practical way to screen large, otherwise intractable chemical spaces and prioritize industrially promising materials for scalable discovery.
method: Generated 60,000 novel MOFs using reinforcement learning optimized for CO/H2O selectivity.
Applied a predictor funnel to iteratively filter candidates down to 10,986 higher-scoring MOFs.
Used CGCNN-based property predictions to build a fitness function with application-specific criteria.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports two top MOFs that passed synthesis criteria, including a Cr-based candidate with 230% higher photocatalyst score than the control and a Zn-based candidate outperforming the best control across relevant metrics.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the learned predictors and fitness-function choices, so real-world synthesis and experimental validation are still necessary.
paper_title: Machine Learning for Designing Undesignable Metal-Organic Frameworks
